The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c7ef1ec44ffd8d7a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. statement: Let (X, F) be a smooth connected complex projective contact manifold of dimension 2n + 1, where n ≥ 1. Its second Betti number determines the following alternatives. 1. If b2(X) = 1, then (X, F) is contact-isomorphic to the adjoint variety Yg, with its canonical contact distribution, for a simple complex Lie algebra g. 2. If b2(X) ≥ 2, then there is a smooth connected complex projective manifold Z of dimension n + 1 and a biholomorphism X ≃ P(T∗ Z). Here P(T∗Z) parametrizes lines in cotangent spaces, equivalently hyperplanes in tangent spaces. This assertion identifies the underlying manifolds, without imposing compatibility with the given distribution F. Conversely, every adjoint variety of complex dimension 2n + 1 and every projectivized cotangent bundle in the second alternative admits a contact structure. Thus these are precisely the underlying manifolds of smooth connected complex projective contact manifolds in these dimensions.
